W Dumbbell, straight DB path.  Slow and controlled hinge, explode up with loose arms.  Retract scap at top.
Treat it like a kickback.  Elbow doesn’t move.
Pull up programming: get to 5 x 10 clean pull ups, then add weight.
Load a decent amount of weight.  Tension on legs and arms before pulling, be fast and explode up.
Keep back super flat, minimal momentum to get the bar up
Arms straight overhead.  Get on top of the ball before slamming, tippy-toes and all.  Fast, powerful slam
If possible, go TRX, Y-pull aparts.  If not, just traditional pull
If possible, do on physioball.  Stable, no rocking back and forth.  Get dumbbell down to shoulders
